title: Determinants of Channel Profitability: Retailers’ Control over Product Selections as Contracting Leverage
eligible_reason: Structural demand and supply model of retailer-manufacturer contracting (vendor allowances, replacement threats) in a grocery category; second-stage OLS regressions of recovered profit measures on chain characteristics with market-time FE. No binary staggered treatment and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: main_script.m: demand_rep (Table 4), contracts_rep, bootstrap_rep, regressions.m (Tables 5-8, 11-13: dep. vars such as % of products with vendor allowances and % change in profits regressed on store counts, shelf space, national-chain and private-label dummies with market_id FE; bootstrap SEs), decomposition_rep (Tables 9-10). Regression inventory empty (MATLAB matrix algebra).
data_files_note: README: 'dataset_sim.mat - simulation dataset'; regressions.m also assigns the secondary-market indicator at random for the replication.
data_provenance_note: Simulation dataset in place of IRI/RefUSA data.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
